ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 35-40% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) vs 60-65% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) on the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Asymmetric pigmentation; the right lobe (viewer's perspective) contains a dense, contiguous field of white mottled blobs covering the medial and central region. The left lobe is predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with a singular high-contrast white patch at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a measured interior angle of approximately 52 degrees; the central vertex is partially obscured by splash/water surface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with a pixel amplitude of 3-7 pixels visible along the superior trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lateral margins exhibit a strong convex sweep from the base, transitioning into a tapered, slightly upward-curved distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct clusters of high-relief, brownish-tan circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the lobe tips; minor irregularities in the trailing edge topography suggest historical tissue loss or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme hemispheric asymmetry in pigmentation patterns between the left and right fluke lobes.
